{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Freon Drevan]] operated a '''bootlegging business''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It was fully licensed but nevertheless sold knockoff merchandise that were produced in its factories. When fellow Xexto [[Niai Fieso]] was promoted to his side, the two expanded the business into a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation. Fieso embezzled credits and sold Drevan out to authorities; he fled the [[Troiken system/Legends|Troiken system]] before a raid landed Drevan in jail and lost him his business license.
